title: Leprosy Diagnosed in Germany – A Retrospective Analysis
summary: Leprosy is a rare infectious disease that occurs only sporadically in Germany. Nevertheless, new cases are diagnosed every year, mainly in people with previous stays in countries where leprosy is more common. The aim of this study is to systematically collect and analyze all leprosy cases diagnosed in Germany over recent years for the first time. Anonymized medical data from multiple centers will be retrospectively analyzed. The results are intended to improve understanding of leprosy in Germany and support optimized medical care.

interventions.name: Patients with a first diagnosis of leprosy in Germany whose anonymized clinical and epidemiological data are retrospectively collected and analyzed.

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
First diagnosis of leprosy in Germany
Diagnosis made between 01 January 2010 and 31 December 2024
Diagnosis and/or treatment at one of the participating study centers
Availability of anonymized epidemiological and clinical baseline data
Exclusion criteria:
Leprosy diagnoses outside the defined study period
Patients diagnosed with leprosy before entering Germany without a first diagnosis in Germany
Cases with insufficient or non-analyzable data
Non-anonymized datasets
